# Warlock Devtools

> Package: `@warlock.js/devtools`

> Development-only dashboard for Warlock.js apps at /__warlock: request timeline, queries with EXPLAIN, N+1 detection, dev mailbox, logs, cache operations and the route map. Refuses to run outside development.

## Skills

- [devtools-overview](@warlock.js/devtools/devtools-overview/SKILL.md): Development-only dashboard for Warlock.js apps at `/__warlock`: request timeline (router + page middleware, loaders, render, deferred values), every SQL/Mongo query with EXPLAIN, N+1 warnings naming the file and line, a dev mailbox, logs, cache operations and the route map. Use for: "why is this page slow", "which queries does this request run", "find N+1 queries", "see the email my app just sent in dev", "open the dashboard". Install with `warlock add devtools`; never registered in warlock.config.ts. Not this package: production monitoring/APM or OpenTelemetry export — use `http.tracing` hooks in @warlock.js/core; slow-query logging in production — subscribe to cascade `dataSourceRegistry.on("query")` yourself.
